transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: It appears there has been an...accident. I assure you, Slughorn, that I have not used your cauldron, nor do I have any recollection of crystallized pineapple. It's fortunate the Potions Guild is not due for another three weeks.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: An *accident*? Severus, are you quite well?! The pineapple is *smashed* on the floor, right next to *your* clumsy footwork, and that is *my* best self-stirring cauldron, bubbling away, clearly just used! Don't try to pull the wool over my eyes! And the Potions Guild is absolutely due today, not in three weeks! I received the owl this morning, informing me they'd moved up the inspection. They'll be here any minute! Look at this mess! The flobberworms are out of their jar, the moonstone is scattered... it's a disaster!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Flobberworms? Moonstone? I see. It appears there has been a serious breach of the Apparition Ban we have in place. Someone, clearly unskilled, has Apparated into the storeroom. This is fortunate, as it is the only explanation for this... variety of chaos. We must inform the Headmaster at once.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Sputtering) A *breach of the Apparition Ban*? Severus, what in Merlin's beard are you talking about?! I've just walked in here through the main entrance, and the mess is clearly from someone *rummaging* through everything! There's no residual magic from Apparition, just... well, just a catastrophic lack of tidiness! And don't try to change the subject, you know perfectly well the Potions Guild is due! Are you feeling alright, dear boy? You're quite pale. Perhaps a spot of pepper-up potion is in order? After you've helped me clean this up, of course! We haven't a moment to lose!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, you are correct. The Potions Guild's arrival is imminent, and it appears we have more pressing concerns than sorting out the events leading to this...unfortunate state of affairs. If you would allow me to assist in the cleanup, we can still salvage a semblance of order before their arrival.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, well, finally some sense! Yes, yes, come on then, don't just stand there, Severus! A semblance of order, you say? It'll take a miracle to achieve even that! Quick, quick, grab that *Scourgify* charm – no, not that one, the extra-strength one, near the powdered dragon scales! We need to get this crystallized pineapple off the floor before it attracts every doxey in the castle. And for heaven's sake, put those flobberworms back in their jar! They're wriggling all over the mandrake roots! This is all quite ghastly, quite ghastly indeed! Move, Severus, move!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: (Casting the Scourgify charm) There, that should remove the worst of the pineapple. I shall endeavor to return the flobberworms to their jar. Your...enthusiastic direction is appreciated, Slughorn. However, I must point out that had you not left your cauldron unattended and the storeroom unlocked, we would not find ourselves in this predicament. The Potions Guild will be here any moment, and we must ensure that what they see is nothing less than impeccable.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Huffing) Good, good, that's better. "Unattended" and "unlocked," you say? Severus, I left you in charge! You *promised* me you'd look after the storeroom! My cauldron was clearly *used*, not merely "unattended"! It was *your* responsibility to keep everything in order! And "impeccable"? We'll be lucky if it's merely *not an utter disgrace*! Quick, the moonstone! It's still scattered amongst the grindylow teeth! We simply must make it presentable. This is dreadful, Severus, dreadful!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The moonstone...yes, that will require particular care. (Gathering the碎片) It appears that someone, in their haste to rummage through the contents, did not consider the fragility of certain components. We are, however, making progress. The Potions Guild will be here shortly, and we must be ready. I recommend you take a moment to compose yourself, Slughorn. It would not do to present a state of disarray not only in the storeroom, but in one's composure as well.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Waving a hand dismissively, but still pacing frantically) Compose myself? Severus, how can I possibly compose myself when my entire reputation hangs by a thread, and that thread is currently entangled with a dozen escaped flobberworms and the Minister's ruined pineapple?! Of course, we're making progress, because *I'm* directing things! Someone, indeed, did not consider fragility – that someone being *you*, I presume, when you were rummaging about, or perhaps when you were... well, whatever it was you were doing! Just gather it quickly, dear boy! And wipe down that shelf! There's a suspicious green stain there that absolutely *wasn't* there this morning! We haven't time for pleasantries, just action!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The green stain...hm. It is not, in fact, a pleasant green, is it? Rather a bilious hue. One wonders what... No matter. It appears we have a crisis on our hands. There is, however, no need for concern. I assure you, Slughorn, that with your...vibrant leadership and my...methodical approach, we shall present a storeroom that would meet the exacting standards of the Potions Guild. Provided, of course, we do not continue to bicker like...well, like a pair of flobberworms. It is in our best interest to focus on the task at hand. The Potions Guild is due, and they are known for their punctuality.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (A sharp intake of breath, then a huffy exhale) "Vibrant leadership," indeed! And "methodical approach" for a mess *you* helped create! Very well, Severus, very well! We haven't time to split hairs or wriggle like flobberworms – though goodness knows, it's a tempting thought! The guild *is* known for punctuality, which means they're practically knocking on the door! The bilious green stain! You're right, it's ghastly! Get a strong cleaning solution on that *immediately*! And check the inventory lists — where did the pickled newt eyes go? I distinctly remember putting them on the third shelf, not... not scattered among the dried bat spleens! This is an absolute catastrophe! Hurry, man, hurry!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
The pickled newt eyes...hm. They were, indeed, not among the dried bat spleens. (Picking up a small, wet object) Here, Slughorn, it appears they were...submerged in something rather...moist. The bilious green stain, I presume? It seems we have a..._tE
(Interrupted by a knock on the door) The Potions Guild! They're here! (Turning to Snape with a wild, panicking expression) For the love of Merlin, Severus! The storeroom is still in disarray! There's no time! We must show them something... anything! Quick, what can we do? Use some sort of...储藏室美化咒语? Or... or... a misdirection spell? anything to... to...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Eyes wide, practically vibrating with terror) They're *here*?! Already?! Oh, this is it! This is the end of my esteemed career! Submerged?! The pickled newt eyes?! Oh, the *humanity*! That bilious green stain has infected them! It's a disaster, an utter, unmitigated catastrophe! A beautification charm? Severus, are you mad?! It would be instantly detected! We need... we need something more subtle! A Glamour Charm, perhaps? No, no, too obvious! What about a powerful Disillusionment Charm over the *worst* bits? Or... or we could just herd them into the other storeroom! No, no, that's even worse! They'll think I'm hiding something! What do we *do*, Severus?! This is all your fault, you know! My reputation! My perfect record! Gone!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Calm yourself, Slughorn. (Snape's voice is firm, though not unkind) There is a solution. I shall cast a Fverbis Jergingus Charm over the affected area. It will render the area undetectable to the eye. You will need to focus on the inventory lists. Ensure everything is accounted for, and in its proper place. We have mere moments. Use your time wisely, and remember, a confident demeanor can mask many a sin. Now, if you would direct the guests to the main storeroom, I shall attend to the...troublesome details.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Gasping for air) A... a *Fverbis Jergingus* Charm? Severus, are you certain that's... that's robust enough? They're the Potions Guild, not some first-year students! They have detecting charms stronger than a Bowtruckle's grip! (Eyes darting wildly between Snape and the door) Inventory lists! Yes, yes, the lists! Where are they?! Oh, Merlin's beard, they're under that pile of spilled gillywater! And the pickled newt eyes are still... *submerged*! This is all quite beyond salvation, I tell you! "Confident demeanor," you say? I'm about to faint! Just... just do whatever you can, Severus! And quickly! I'll try to... to *distract* them! Oh, this is dreadful! Absolutely dreadful!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The Fverbis Jergingus Charm is quite effective, Slughorn, when applied by someone of...adequate skill. (Snape's eyes meet Slughorn's for a brief, reassuring moment) Focus on the lists. Account for everything. The Potions Guild will respect a well-organized storeroom, even if it does not reflect the events of this morning. Now, if you would care to greet our guests with your usual...charming demeanor, I shall ensure that the areas of concern are...attend to. Remember, Slughorn, confidence is key. It often掩盖s a multitude of sins. And, if you would be so kind, inform me if any members of the Guild attempt to inspect the...affected areas.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(Scoffs, but a flicker of hope, or perhaps just desperation, crosses his face.) "Adequate skill," indeed, Severus! Let's hope your "adequate skill" is enough to fool the Guild's most discerning eyes! Right, the lists! (He scrambles, frantically patting his pockets, then dives towards a slightly less disastrous-looking corner, rummaging through parchments.) Inventory, inventory... oh, where is that blasted quill?!

(He glances at the door, then back at Snape, a pleading look in his eyes.) "Charming demeanor," you say? I feel about as charming as a grumpy gurdyroot! Very well! I shall... I shall try to guide them, but if they so much as *sniff* in the direction of that bilious stain or those poor pickled newt eyes, you'd better have worked a miracle, Severus! This is all on your head, you know! If my career goes up in a puff of smoke, I'll hold *you* personally responsible! Just... just get it done! And yes, I'll alert you if they even *think* of straying! Just... don't let me down! Oh, this is simply dreadful!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, Slughorn. I shall endeavor to...rectify the situation. You focus on the inventory. If the Potions Guild does detect anything amiss, I am certain they will understand the...unique challenges of maintaining an organized storeroom in the midst of...certain...events. (He gives a brief, uncharacteristic nod to Slughorn) Now, if you would be so kind as to manage the guests, I shall...attend to the details. Remember, Slughorn, a well-kept storeroom often speaks volumes about its keeper. Let us ensure that, at the very least, it speaks well of you.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Snape devises a creative, albeit dishonest, explanation for the mess: 'It appears there has been a serious breach of the Apparition Ban we have in place.'

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: After initial deflection, Snape commits to addressing the crisis, stating, 'with your...vibrant leadership and my...methodical approach, we shall present a storeroom that would meet the exacting standards of the Potions Guild.'

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Snape's communication is direct and often sarcastic, rather than enthusiastic or socially engaging, as shown by his 'Your...enthusiastic direction is appreciated, Slughorn.'

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Snape frequently deflects blame and offers criticisms, such as 'had you not left your cauldron unattended and the storeroom unlocked, we would not find ourselves in this predicament.'

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Snape remains remarkably calm and composed under extreme pressure, offering solutions and reassuring Slughorn with 'Calm yourself, Slughorn. There is a solution.'
